name: io.github.Finanzgoblin/spectra-mcp-server
description: Makes Spectra Finance discoverable and usable by AI agents via MCP. 37 tools, 10 chains, read-only. Covers yield discovery, PT/YT analysis, looping strategies, Morpho integration (borrow + supply side), MetaVault discovery & curator risk management, cross-protocol Pendle comparison, portfolio tracking, on-chain Curve quoting, and more.
